Parent epic: bd-01KY1BVCQVAYT48NJEGR7M2CP6

Generalize the completed one-contrast/largest-root canonical effect to typed multi-contrast hypotheses and an explicit MANOVA statistic catalog. Model contrast subspaces, estimability, rank, repeated-root/subspace semantics, and statistics such as Roy, Wilks, Pillai, and Hotelling-Lawley as distinct named estimands rather than mode strings. Reuse PreparedContrastGeometry, runwise moments, OperatorProgram, and Gale; route genuinely general spectral gaps upstream. Acceptance requires independent dense/base-R fixtures, contrast-basis invariance, rank-deficiency and repeated-root tests, fold-safe held-out evaluation, and JVM/Scala.js parity.
set.title: One-shot canonical effects: multiple contrasts and full MANOVA statistics
